svg.title: Nine stages from raw parquet to a checked submission file; the GPU stages add up to about 150 hours, the students alone to 82

cc:Work.dc:title: Nine stages from raw parquet to a checked submission file; the GPU stages add up to about 150 hours, the students alone to 82
cc:Work.dc:description: A vertical chain of nine boxes between the competition data (17.9 GiB zipped) at the top and the submission file at the bottom: flatten, exploration probability, candidate inputs, teacher rankers, teacher files, students, fine-tune, ensemble and file, pre-submission gate. A column on the right gives hardware and run time in the original run: the CPU stages take seconds to about half an hour, encoder pre-training 5.2 GPU-hours, the 25 teacher rankers 58.0, the 20 students 81.8 and their fine-tunes 6.6.
